ov: About 200 species of eels found worldwide, almost all marine. They hide in crevices to ambush prey and have to keep gulping to breathe.

why.dg: Mostly to eat: some large morays carry the toxin that causes ciguatera poisoning.
why.ac: Nocturnal, which is one reason its breeding is so rarely seen.
why.et: Some big morays carry toxins that cause ciguatera poisoning, so they are not recommended to eat.

rg: Seas worldwide; a few in brackish or fresh water.
fx: A moray must keep opening and closing its mouth to pass water over its gills.
